original_test_intent: Verify the NVSM aggregate installed-memory view matches the approved total capacity, controller/channel/NUMA topology and health for all memory resources.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected total capacity, memory type/speed, controller/channel/NUMA distribution and health manifest; run exact `nvsm show memory` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/status/health; compare aggregate and per-domain values, including units and disabled/reserved memory, without changing configuration.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies aggregate memory/topology manifest and dispositions every capacity, distribution or health deviation.
required_inputs: Expected total usable/physical capacity and unit policy
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or change memory/NUMA/firmware settings
Do not substitute per-DIMM count for aggregate topology

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal memory command and compare aggregate and domain records to the approved topology manifest.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create aggregate and NUMA/controller/channel expected/observed tables with physical/usable capacity, speed/type and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes capacity and distribution correctness explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Per-DIMM presence cannot alone prove usable capacity or NUMA/controller aggregation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reserved memory and unit rounding can create legitimate physical-versus-usable differences requiring policy.

project_override_considerations: Platform recipe defines memory interleave, reserved capacity, NUMA grouping and accepted speed bins.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target installed-memory correctness/health; missing expected topology is a project input and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and memory manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Adds aggregate-versus-domain consistency and physical-versus-usable capacity semantics while preserving the separate per-DIMM case.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correct DIMM population can still expose the wrong usable capacity or NUMA distribution because of firmware reservation, training or interleave settings. Aggregate and per-domain totals must reconcile with the approved topology.
